name: Performance report
description: Sends you a scheduled summary of your realized trading performance over a look-back window — deals closed, realized profit, win rate, average result, and best and worst deal — plus a snapshot of your current open positions. Read-only: it reads your closed-deal history, it never places or changes a trade. On the Hub each instance reports its own performance, labeled with the instance name so you can tell them apart.
author: core
